s1.title: Welcome to your merchant space
s1.text: Collections, receivables and payouts: everything is here.

s2.title: Collect a payment
s2.text: In “Collect”, enter the customer’s 8-digit code and the amount. They confirm with their PIN. They can also scan your QR.

s3.title: Get settled at D+{days}
s3.text: Each confirmed payment is settled at D+{days}, minus the commission of its type. Follow it in “Receivables” then “Payouts”.

s4.title: Your credit types
s4.text: You accept the types set by FlexiPay; customers can only pay with those. They are listed in “My shop”.

s1.title: Welcome to your company space
s1.text: One balance per credit type: Meals, Clothing, Fuel, Gifts.

s2.title: Add your employees
s2.text: In “Employees”, one by one or by CSV import. Each receives their access.

s3.title: Order credits
s3.text: An amount per type, then a transfer and its proof. FlexiPay validates and credits each type.

s4.title: Allocate them
s4.text: In “Allocation”, choose a type and the employees: only that type is debited.

s1.title: Welcome to FlexiPay
s1.text: Your company gives you credits: one balance per type, to use at merchants that accept it.

s2.title: Pay with your code
s2.text: In “Pay”, show your code. The merchant types it, you confirm with your PIN.

s3.title: Or scan the merchant
s3.text: Scan their QR or type their 6-digit code, choose the type and amount.

s4.title: Keep your PIN secret
s4.text: No one at FlexiPay will ever ask for it. Change it any time in “Security”.
